task.title: Replace GIF branding frame by frame and verify the publication-media set
task.input: The original 361-frame GIF, brand-static-media, the current wordmark and the original timeline
task.output: brand-media; a rebranded GIF, same-size pause frame, frame-by-frame branding/timing report and publishable set
task.accept: 1) Preserve original JPG/GIF hashes. List old-brand appearances, perspective changes, transitions and reappearances after occlusion across all 361 frames, and cover each completely with PackJoyU. Also recheck the JPG old-logo locations from T3; the first/last frames and all listed locations must contain no old or missed logo (E-26). 2) Compare every frame presentation time/order and the total 30.08-second loop against the original timeline; all must match. Overlay comparison must show no newly introduced misalignment or jitter. Any failure marks the copy unfinished and excludes it from publication, while preserving originals for rollback (E-30). 3) Output a decodable GIF, a same-size paused still and hashes. Record GPT Dot production evidence or per-item not-yet-executed status according to T3 actual tool availability; do not falsely report completion.
